name: Teams
author: rams
description: Microsoft Teams as a first-class citizen of the Omarchy bar: live presence, mic and screen-share state, meeting mode that silences the desktop and holds off the lock screen, click-to-answer call toasts, a global mute that works from fullscreen, Teams retinted to your theme in ~40ms — and a one-click install of teams-for-linux if it is missing.

barWidget.description: Presence and call state from Teams for Linux, with mute/camera/hand controls and your next meetings.

schema.label: Hide the icon when Teams is not running
schema.description: Off keeps a dimmed icon in the bar that starts Teams when clicked.

schema.label: Show the status text next to the icon
schema.description: Adds "Available", "In a call · Muted" and so on beside the glyph. Ignored on a vertical bar.

schema.label: Right click
schema.description: Middle click always focuses or starts Teams.

schema.label: Calendar look-ahead (days)
schema.description: How far ahead the "Next up" list asks for. Requires the Graph API to be enabled in teams-for-linux; without it the list stays empty.
